name: What kind of paint and primer should be used for durable peeling paint repair?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint and primer should be used for durable peeling paint repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: For durable peeling paint repair, selecting the right paint and primer is critical. A high-quality, oil-based or acrylic latex primer specifically designed for problem surfaces and good adhesion is essential to seal the surface and provide a strong base. For the topcoat, choose a premium exterior-grade acrylic latex paint that offers flexibility, mildew resistance, and durability against weather elements. For interiors, a washable, durable acrylic latex paint is generally recommended. Always match the paint type to the primer for best results.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a high-quality primer designed for adhesion and a premium exterior-grade acrylic latex paint for durability.
